svg.title: Grey Panels
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Four gray-value panels after small museum checklist photograph. All four are grouped as gray, including near-white central panel. Unequal lower support edges approximate the photograph; wall below panels omitted. Exact panel seams and projection remain uncertain.
